current.text: Jamahl Mosley is the new head coach this season.
Dejounte Murray, Trey Murphy III and Zion Williamson are locked into the starting lineup.
Yves Missi looks like the starting center. Derik Queen does not seem set to start.
The last starting spot is open between Jeremiah Fears and Herbert Jones.
A Pelicans beat reporter expects Fears to start over Jones.
Saddiq Bey is talked about as a starter who may close games in lineups with Zion at center.
The guard roles are unclear and the experts cannot make sense of the lineup plans.
Derik Queen and Zion Williamson are a poor fit together, which limits how much they can share the floor.
The rotation is crowded. About eight players could start: Fears, Murray, Jones, Murphy, Zion, Bey, Missi and Queen. Bennedict Mathurin was added to the bench. This creates a minutes crunch.
The team needs to trade someone to make room for Mathurin, possibly Jordan Hawkins or Micah Peavy.
The team will not go into the luxury tax. It is about 8.27 million USD under the line with 14 players and cannot use the full non-taxpayer mid-level exception.
The team lacks shooting. Trey Murphy III is basically the only floor spacer.
The team is stuck between a win-now timeline and a rebuild timeline and will not commit to either one.
The Pelicans are a weak team near the bottom of the West. One projection has about 34 wins, still not a playoff team. The win total of 27.5 ranks 26 of 30.
One expert does not expect the team to pack it in and start Fears over Murray.
The Pelicans are expected to rest Zion Williamson often. With 16 back-to-backs (rank 26 of 30), there are many chances to sit him.
The fantasy playoff schedule is strong: 11 games in weeks 19 to 21 (rank 4 of 30), with no back-to-back in week 21.

durable.text: Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first identity and switches less than Willie Green did.

note: New Orleans is a weak, crowded team under new coach Jamahl Mosley. Murray, Murphy and Zion are set as starters, and Missi now looks like the starting center over Queen, which helps Missi and hurts Queen, Fears and Bey. Watch early who wins the fifth starting spot (Fears, Jones or Bey), whether a trade clears the logjam, and how often Zion sits during a heavy back-to-back schedule. The strong playoff schedule (11 games) helps anyone who keeps a role.
